reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant external risk was found for SOL at the October 4, 2026 snapshot. Solana’s official status showed all systems operational with no incidents reported through October 3; the next modeled supply release appears modest.

facts.fact: Solana’s official status page reported all systems operational and no incidents on October 3, 2026. ([status.solana.com](https://status.solana.com/?utm_source=openai))

A Solana engineering update published September 10 said activation of larger V1 transactions was delayed to Epoch 1035 for application readiness; no fresh incident or activation notice was identified in this check. ([solana.com](https://solana.com/news/solana-changelog-september-10-2026?utm_source=openai))

A supply tracker models recurring staking-reward issuance of about 401,600 SOL per week (0.068% of float), with the next event October 11, 2026; this is not a large near-term cliff unlock. ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/unlocks/solana?utm_source=openai))
